title: Gail Kim Gail Kim Calls Out Reporter BJ Bethel for 'Made-Up' AEW Claims After ESPN Controversy - NewsBreak
text:
By Thomas Lowson ,
47 minutes ago
Pro wrestling veteran Gail Kim has called out reporter BJ Bethel for allegedly making up reports about her, following his recent exit from SEScoops.
Bethel was cut from SEScoops after an ‘exclusive’ that claimed that ESPN wanted out of its deal with WWE was refuted by ESPN itself.
SEScoops admitted that they had not reached out to ESPN before publishing, and admitted that there had been serious shortcomings in their process.

Taking to Twitter, Kim shared that she had no sympathy for Bethel, who will now need to seek work in wrestling journalism elsewhere.
In 2025, Bethel claimed that Kim had contacted several people about an opportunity in AEW, only for no one to reach out to her.
Kim later shared that this was not true, and that following her termination from TNA, she was reached out to by AEW’s Sonjay Dutt.
Dutt inquired about her wrestling for AEW, though Kim made clear she’s retired, a much different version of events than what Bethel claimed.
